approval_scope: A-owned authorization, strong-auth, idempotency, audit and exact-source requirements for D canonical config writers; not deployment authorization or whole-v12 freeze

backfill.mode: offline maintenance only; no new HTTP operation approved
backfill.receipt_storage: D must implement/review a typed durable maintenance receipt ledger; current 066 config_update success is not a backfill receipt

changes: expand automatic deletion or alert suppression capability

rules: Compute classification from locked current/proposed effective config and independently resolved registry contents, never caller booleans or registry hashes alone.
Validate current authenticated actor/session, revocation and current RBAC inside the mutation transaction, including committed receipt reads.
Forbid granting caller new security/destructive permission, changing built-in role sets, or removing the last security_admin binding.

Resolve all exact typed refs and required registries against current environment; retain still-referenced historical identities/versions. Provider/network work completes before DB locks; transaction-time guards reject stale observations.
Use the frozen D lock order, capacity reservation and final authority recheck in the caller-owned transaction; A adapters cannot commit it.
BootstrapAdmission, read scope and VerifiedConfigBackfillSource do not authorize PUT/rollback/backfill.

new_versions.expected_version: must equal locked current active version for a new mutation; stale -> 409 version_conflict before key/nonce consumption
new_versions.update: full replacement; append a new monotonic version with canonical bytes and all materialized columns from the SAME validated ConfigValues object
new_versions.rollback: read exact rollback_from_version, re-resolve historical typed refs in current environment, apply identical security/reduction checks, append new version with copied_from_version; never activate or overwrite the historical row
new_versions.canonical: UTF-8 JCS ConfigValues, 2..262144 bytes, same SHA-256/size/materialized columns as persisted row; no request-only reason or proof in effective config
new_versions.decoder_limit: DecodeBootstrapConfig only accepts enabled=false; D needs a full ConfigValues decoder for mutation, not the bootstrap-only decoder
atomic_state: config_update terminal operation and immutable response
new_versions.monitoring: config mutation/rollback must not reset first-enabled or monitoring history

request_hash_input.request: strict request body after ConfigValues canonical normalization; rollback uses only its strict selector/expected_version/reason body

idempotency.request_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS(input), lowercase hex; object keys sorted, no whitespace; arrays retain the validated canonical ConfigValues order
rules: Authenticate/authorize current actor before receipt lookup.
Same scope/key/hash with complete committed receipt returns original HTTP status/resource/immutable response, without nonce re-consumption, activation or new audit/mutation side effects.
Same key with different hash -> 409 idempotency_conflict.
Receipt lookup precedes new-proof consumption and expected_version execution guard; successful replay does not re-execute a stale original expected_version.
Pre-transaction auth/validation/readiness/version/state failures occupy no key and consume no nonce.
Unknown commit requires independent same-target/key/hash observation under current authority; never blindly repeat a write.
Tombstone-only same hash -> 410 idempotency_expired, different hash -> 409; destructive key tombstones are permanent for installation lifetime, standard retention follows v12.
Bind trusted issuer/key purpose/version, audience, actor subject/session, MFA method, endpoint/request_hash/idempotency_key and database-time age/expiry.
Check nonce HMAC under every retained historical key version before unique insertion.
Consume nonce with target mutation, real operation result anchor and returned audit intent ID in ONE transaction.
Required proof must remain valid through final guard/commit, not just parsing.
Do not store raw proof, nonce, credential or session token in audit/ledger. Nonce required only for applicable new public config mutation, not replay.

details: actor type/id and redacted session binding
audit.limits: redacted audit details <=64KiB; no raw canonical body or proof/credential
rules: Return actual audit_logs.id from intent insert for nonce FK, never SELECT MAX(id).
Audit intent/result, receipt and mutation commit or roll back together; failure/capacity shortage blocks success.
Do not record a speculative result after unknown commit or expose private DB/provider errors.

backfill.authority: independently authenticated, purpose-specific offline write grant; no allow-all/default or HTTP caller-supplied permission
grant_binding: stored original canonical SHA-256 and byte size
source_rules: An original installation/version-bound canonical source is required; example, test fixture, candidate lab bundle, hash or materialized-column reconstruction is not original provenance.
Copy input bytes before callbacks; verify exact canonical form, stored hash/size and EVERY materialized column in the WRITE transaction against locked row.
Foreign installation, wrong version/hash/size, unknown source, missing grant or changed row rejects write.
Write only canonical_config_json NULL -> exact original bytes; do not change config_sha256/size, values/version/row_version, created_by/reason/time, active pointer or enablement.
Existing different bytes -> conflict; same bytes may receive an accurately labeled no-change receipt only after independent authorization and full recheck.
Missing original source leaves NULL and preserves read 503; do not synthesize or update old hash.
Final guard rechecks current grant/revocation/deadline, source pin, locked row and audit/capacity before caller-owned commit.
backfill.storage_gap: D must review and implement the maintenance receipt schema/unique guard before real backfill; do not borrow config_update, provider registration or a read receipt to bypass existing semantics.

acceptance_tests: ordinary PUT with configure; viewer/operator denied
security change requires configure+security_configure+valid fresh MFA
retention/minimum/required-domain/profile reduction requires destructive+fresh MFA+reason; rollback cannot bypass
stale expected_version, unavailable ref, bad canonical/materialized match leaves key/nonce/state untouched
same-key concurrent requests commit once; different hash conflicts; replay after fresh login remains same actor-scope result
cross-version nonce HMAC replay rejected; nonce/audit/operation failure rolls back all config state
rollback appends a new version and preserves history/first-enabled state
backfill read authorization alone denied; grant revoke/expiry/target/source drift denied
backfill changes only NULL canonical field; audit/receipt failure rolls back; competing backfills commit once
unknown commit observed independently without blind write retry

availability.old_rows: not inferred from 2026-09-23 zero-row inventory; current live row count unverified
